_note: Palettes for comp-neuro graphical abstracts. Use <=3 hues + 1 accent. Pair color with shape (never color-alone). All are print/CMYK-safe and chosen for colorblind legibility where noted.

cell._desc: Cell Press house feel: deep navy structure + a single red accent for the finding.

okabe_ito._desc: Okabe-Ito colorblind-safe categorical palette (use when >2 categories must be distinguished by color).

preview_class_map._desc: When porting a publication hue to the Claude show_widget preview dialect, map to these dark-mode-safe c-* classes.
